title: [ORION-QG QG-22] Minimal hidden-home state quotient for the pinned comm-s2 J5 move
body:
Parent programme: #740
Direct parent: QG-7d information closure PR #860 / issue #836.
Wave-3 state-compression frontier: issue #863 conceptually, but this lane uses fresh identifier QG-22 to avoid the earlier publication/Q3 QG-20 name collision.

## Status

**PROSPECTIVE STATE-QUOTIENT REOPEN — turn the exact QG-7d CANNOT_CHECK into a minimal-information theorem/refutation.**

The protected QG-7d information-closure dual harness established a precise obstruction: for a fixed visible pinned-PP T4b state, the omitted phantom-home environment ranges over all `4^6=4096` phase-free local assignments and changes the proposed J5 Restore delta across every integer from `-4` through `+4`. Therefore the current visible quotient cannot determine whether J5 is non-increasing.

QG-22 does **not** weaken that negative. It asks the next representation question:

> What is the smallest prospectively frozen structural signature of each hidden phantom-home branch that determines the exact J5 local delta, and does adding that state remove the information-theoretic ambiguity without importing the full raw environment?

A compact exact quotient is useful even if the all-n B'' theorem still remains open; a failure to compress is equally valid.

## Disclosed exploratory derivation before freeze

Exploratory first-principles analysis of the already-disclosed QG-7d local formula found that for one branch with hidden letters `(a,b,c)` and fixed J5 modifier `m`,

`delta_m(a,b,c) = F3(a,b,c) - F3(a,b*m,c)`

has values `{-2,-1,0,1,2}` on the complete 64-state branch domain.

A frozen candidate Boolean language was then checked exploratorily. The canonical five predicates

- `b0 := [b=I]`
- `ab := [a=b]`
- `ac := [a=c]`
- `bm0 := [b*m=I]` (equivalently `b=m`)
- `a_bm := [a=b*m]`

partition the 64 states into 18 nonempty cells and determine `delta_m` exactly for both relevant modifiers `m=Z` and `m=X`. No 4-predicate subset of the frozen candidate language determines the delta.

Because these facts were used to formulate the lane, QG-22 is **confirmatory**, not blind discovery. The dual harness must rederive them independently and may refute them.

## Frozen candidate language

The complete candidate predicate library is fixed before official outcome:

`a0,b0,c0,ab,ac,bc,am,bm0,cm,a_bm,c_bm`

with their literal phase-free Pauli meanings. No predicate may be added after outcome in V1.

The selected canonical candidate signature is frozen as `(b0,ab,ac,bm0,a_bm)` using lexicographic predicate order. A positive must also prove minimality within the **entire frozen 11-predicate library**, not only against the selected five.

## Q1 — exact branch quotient

For each modifier `m in {Z,X}` enumerate all 64 `(a,b,c)` states from primitive phase-free Pauli algebra and compute exact J5 delta.

Required positive facts:
- selected five-predicate signature has zero mixed-delta cells;
- exactly 18 nonempty selected-signature cells;
- the signature-to-delta table is identical under the canonical Pauli relabel that maps the two modifier controls;
- exhaustive subset search over all 11 frozen predicates finds minimum determining cardinality exactly 5;
- serialize every tied cardinality-5 subset and a concrete mixed-delta counterexample for every cardinality-4 subset.

## Q2 — two-branch composition

The pinned PP hidden-home contribution is the sum of the two branch deltas (`m=Z` and `m=X`). Verify exhaustively over all 4096 six-letter environments that the pair of five-bit branch signatures determines the exact total delta.

Required controls:
- reproduce parent total range `[-4,+4]` and every integer in between;
- reproduce the parent 4096-domain size;
- no mixed total-delta cell under the paired signature.

This establishes information sufficiency of the enriched hidden-home state for **pricing J5**, not all-n normalization.

## Q3 — compression accounting

Report:
- raw branch states = 64;
- exact selected-signature cells = 18;
- raw two-branch environments = 4096;
- realized paired-signature cells;
- minimum frozen-predicate cardinality = 5;
- whether an exact delta-only quotient is strictly coarser than the structural signature (expected, but it receives no structural state authority by itself because it encodes the answer rather than explanatory coordinates).

## Q4 — next theorem interface, not part of the positive V1 claim

If the state quotient closes, a separate fresh freeze may join the exact hidden-home delta to the visible T4b pinned census and ask whether a **state-conditioned J5/fallback policy** closes all 32,556 PP failures. QG-22 V1 itself cannot claim the B'' all-n identity.

## Dual harness

Generic ORION:
- independently rebuild Pauli multiplication/F3;
- enumerate the complete branch and two-branch domains;
- independently search the full frozen feature-subset lattice;
- verify every minimality counterexample.

Native ORION-Q:
- requires exact parent QG-7d information-closure binding;
- keeps `STATE_QUOTIENT`, `J5_DELTA_DETERMINATION`, and `ALL_N_NORMALIZATION` separate;
- blocks any all-n authority in V1.

## Honest terminals

- `QG22_HIDDEN_HOME_J5_DELTA_EXACTLY_DETERMINED_BY_MINIMAL_5_PREDICATE_STATE`
- `QG22_SELECTED_STATE_INSUFFICIENT__MIXED_DELTA_CELL_FOUND`
- `QG22_MINIMALITY_REFUTED__SMALLER_FROZEN_SIGNATURE_FOUND`
- `QG22_PARENT_BINDING_GAP`
- `QG22_GENERIC_NATIVE_DISAGREEMENT`
- `QG22_CANNOT_CHECK`

## Claim boundary

Automata/state minimization, partition refinement, Boolean feature minimization and finite exhaustive search are donor methods. Candidate contribution is only the exact compiler-specific hidden-home state quotient and its proof-carrying relationship to the QG-7d information obstruction. No novelty, R6, physical quantum advantage, or all-n B'' completeness follows automatically.

nodes.body: Protected QG-22 execution is GREEN under the dual harness (workflow run 32557926208, job 96994962011; deterministic replay green). Terminal: `QG22_HIDDEN_HOME_J5_DELTA_EXACTLY_DETERMINED_BY_MINIMAL_5_PREDICATE_STATE`. Exact result: minimum determining cardinality is 5 in the frozen 11-predicate language, with 4 tied minima; selected `(b0,ab,ac,bm0,a_bm)` has 18 exact branch states for both X/Z modifiers; all 330 four-predicate subsets have a concrete mixed-delta counterexample; paired 4096 hidden-home environments collapse to 324 exact structural states with 0 mixed-delta cells; parent total range [-4,+4] reproduced exactly. Generic ORION and native ORION-Q both ACCEPT. Authority remains local J5 hidden-home pricing only: `all_n_theorem_authority=false`, novelty/R6/physical-advantage false.
